laneSeedSummaries.D1: geometric mean of eligible finite-positive eventGroupElapsedMilliseconds within one anonymous lane x core superblock
laneSeedSummaries.D2: median of eligible gridAccessorCallsTotal within one anonymous lane x core superblock
laneSeedSummaries.missingRule: no imputation; fail closed if a core cell lacks six lanes x three superblocks

anonymousPairSeparation.perMetricRule: Across the three paired core superblocks, all three signed log-ratios must have the same nonzero direction, at least two of three absolute log-ratios must be at least log(1+threshold), and the median absolute log-ratio must be at least log(1+threshold).
anonymousPairSeparation.pairRule: An anonymous pair is operationally separated if either D1 or D2 passes the per-metric rule.
cellOutputs: separated pair count and fraction at 5, 10, and 20 percent
minimum and median pairwise separation margin without directions or identities
anonymousPairSeparation.statisticalBoundary: n=3 independent superblocks per cell is descriptive pilot evidence, not a confirmatory significance test.

runtimeBoundary.cellTypical: median of the six algorithm-specific process-wall P50 values
runtimeBoundary.cellWorstObserved: maximum of the six algorithm-specific three-replicate process-wall maxima
runtimeBoundary.reason: 180 seconds implies at least about 20 fresh lanes/hour before small gaps; 300 seconds is the largest acceptable planning band and excludes the old multi-minute tail region.

decisionUse: describe where anonymous separation first becomes stable as load rises
describe where runtime crosses 180 and 300 seconds
construct a new 3 x 4 x 4 bounded window whose minimum is above the non-discriminating region and whose maximum is below the long-tail region
do not select exact new unobserved levels solely by interpolated outcome differences; final candidate must be requalified from ordinal 0
